Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error by misidentifying the state of the Umpqua Community College shooting incident, stating it was in Texas instead of Oregon. This mistake occurred despite the WebSurfer correctly retrieving information indicating the event took place near Roseburg, Oregon. The planner seemingly ignored the verified source data from WebSurfer and reached an incorrect conclusion. This reflects an error in synthesizing information or a possible oversight in detail-oriented verification.
